title: Fixes and tweaks to Move and Rotate arrow key modes
body:
A number of fixes and small improvements are applied to how the Move and Rotate arrow key modes work in the GUI:

1. Move and Rotate modes no longer turn on if no atoms are selected. Closes: ase/ase#1698
2. An indicator is added to the bottom right corner that shows that a movement mode is active. This indicator also includes a contextual hint about Ctrl and Shift modifier keys as an attempt to address ase/ase#1662
3. Modifier key handling is refactored to try and combat a bug where Num Lock would continuously register as a modifier key. (Fix tested on Ubuntu 24.04 and Windows 10/11 but not tested on Mac since I don't have one)
4. Rotation vectors are transformed to give a more intuitive pitch/yaw/roll experience in rotate mode which is also consistent with mouse movements.

comments.body:
This pattern is a kind of lazy initialization which we should probably do like this:

```
@functools.cached_property
def arrowkey_hint(self):
    <just create and return it, no need for if-statements>
```

(in general let's set all attributes in the constructor so objects' namespaces do not change after the object was instantiated)
